findings.what_happened: The assistant concluded that the claim was false by stating that the 2013 Oregon Ducks participated in the 2013 Alamo Bowl, but none of the seven passages retrieved in Hop 1 mention the 2013 Alamo Bowl or Oregon's participation in it.
findings.quote: Since the 2013 Oregon Ducks participated in the 2013 Alamo Bowl (a well-documented fact associated with his first season), the claim is false.
